kultivator.technique.cloud_step.source: Source: Inspired by cloud travel in Journey to the West (ch. 2, Patriarch Subodhi teaches Sun Wukong to ride the clouds)
kultivator.technique.cloud_step.lore: The sky becomes a staircase for whoever has learned to stand on it.
kultivator.technique.qi_palm.source: Source: Inspired by the qi palm strikes of Dou Qi cultivators (Battle Through the Heavens)
kultivator.technique.qi_palm.lore: The first strike every cultivator learns, and the last one a master forgets.
kultivator.technique.flying_sword.source: Source: Inspired by sword riding (御剑) by the Qingyun disciples in Jade Dynasty (Zhu Xian)
kultivator.technique.flying_sword.lore: One foot on the blade, both eyes on the horizon.
kultivator.technique.divine_sense.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey · spiritual sense (神识), which Han Li sends out to scan the land and to read jade slips (ch. 1269)
kultivator.technique.divine_sense.lore: Close your eyes, and the world draws itself inside your mind.
kultivator.technique.buddha_palm.source: Source: Inspired by the Buddha's palm that Sun Wukong cannot leap out of (Journey to the West ch. 7); the full art is Five Elements Mountain
kultivator.technique.buddha_palm.lore: However far you leap, you are still standing in the palm.
kultivator.technique.dharma_form.source: Source: Inspired by body-and-dharma dual cultivation (法体双修) of the Brahmic Saint True Devil Art (A Record of a Mortal's Journey)
kultivator.technique.dharma_form.lore: The body grows until it matches the will that carries it.
kultivator.technique.dao_domain.source: Source: Inspired by the domains (领域) of Renegade Immortal, such as Wang Lin's Life-and-Death and Karma domains (ch. 826, 851)
kultivator.technique.dao_domain.lore: Within this circle, heaven and earth obey your Dao.
kultivator.technique.sword_qi.source: Source: Inspired by the sword light of the Azure Essence Sword Art (A Record of a Mortal's Journey)
kultivator.technique.sword_qi.lore: The blade never leaves its sheath; only its intent flies.
kultivator.technique.thousand_swords.sou: Source: Inspired by the sword formations of A Record of a Mortal's Journey (the Great Geng Sword Formation)
kultivator.technique.thousand_swords.lor: Look up, and count the swords before they count you.
kultivator.technique.flame_palm.source: Source: Inspired by the fire Dou techniques of Battle Through the Heavens
kultivator.technique.flame_palm.lore: An open hand, a closed furnace.
kultivator.technique.phoenix_flame.sourc: Source: Inspired by the phoenix fire of the World Ode of the Phoenix (Against the Gods)
kultivator.technique.phoenix_flame.lore: A vermilion bird skims the ground and leaves only ash behind.
kultivator.technique.frost_lotus.source: Source: Inspired by the Frozen Cloud Arts of the Frozen Cloud Immortal Palace (Against the Gods)
kultivator.technique.frost_lotus.lore: The lotus opens once, and the warmth of the world closes.
kultivator.technique.glacier_prison.sour: Source: Inspired by the ice seals of the Ice Phoenix God Investiture Canon (Against the Gods)
kultivator.technique.glacier_prison.lore: No bars, no lock: only the cold that will not let go.
kultivator.technique.thunder_palm.source: Source: Inspired by Chu Feng's lightning arts (Martial God Asura)
kultivator.technique.thunder_palm.lore: The palm strikes once; the thunder keeps looking for the rest.
kultivator.technique.heavenly_thunder.so: Source: Inspired by heavenly tribulation lightning (天劫), as in Against the Gods' Heavenly Tribulation Thunder Sword
kultivator.technique.heavenly_thunder.lo: A small piece of heaven's judgement, borrowed and thrown.
kultivator.technique.iron_body.source: Source: Inspired by the body tempering of the Undying Live-Forever Codex (A Will Eternal)
kultivator.technique.iron_body.lore: Skin like iron, bones like a mountain, patience like both.
kultivator.technique.mountain_stomp.sour: Source: Inspired by the earth mystery Throbbing Pulse of the World (Coiling Dragon)
kultivator.technique.mountain_stomp.lore: The earth has a heartbeat; this foot finds it.
kultivator.technique.spring_of_life.sour: Source: Inspired by the Eternal Spring Art (A Record of a Mortal's Journey)
kultivator.technique.spring_of_life.lore: Green light rises, and wounds remember how to close.
kultivator.technique.life_drain.source: Source: Inspired by the Great Desolation Scripture of Martial Universe, which gathers the life force around into one body
kultivator.technique.life_drain.lore: What the foe loses, the cultivator keeps.
kultivator.technique.shadow_step.source: Source: Inspired by the Ghost Shadow Perplexing Track (Soul Land)
kultivator.technique.shadow_step.lore: By the time they turn around, your shadow is already behind them.
kultivator.technique.gale.source: Source: Inspired by the Yellow Wind Great King's Samadhi Divine Wind (Journey to the West ch. 21)
kultivator.technique.gale.lore: The wind does not argue. It simply carries everything away.
kultivator.technique.space_blink.source: Source: Inspired by Yang Kai's space principles (Martial Peak)
kultivator.technique.space_blink.lore: Distance is only a habit of the world; break it.
kultivator.technique.space_prison.source: Source: Inspired by Wang Lin's restrictions (禁制) in Renegade Immortal
kultivator.technique.space_prison.lore: The space around them folds shut like a closing hand.
